notes: University-wide partial tuition-fee scholarship administered by Linköping University for fee-paying international master's students; no programme or supervising professor is attached to the award (selection is based on admission merit). Verified on official page https://liu.se/en/article/scholarships (stored source URL https://liu.se/en/education/scholarships now returns 404). Only administrative contacts published: infocenter@liu.se and tuitionfees@liu.se per https://liu.se/en/article/scholarships and https://liu.se/en/article/how-to-pay-your-tuition-fee.

University-wide tuition-fee waiver administered by Umeå University alongside autumn admissions for fee-paying bachelor's/master's applicants; no programme or supervising professor is attached to the award. Verified on official page https://www.umu.se/en/education/application-and-admission/scholarships/ (stored source URL https://www.umu.se/en/education/scholarships now returns 404; equivalent page also at https://www.umu.se/en/education/fees-and-scholarships/scholarships). Only administrative contact published: tuitionfees@umu.se.

Central EU scheme: the Erasmus Mundus Catalogue is an EACEA-maintained, annually updated listing of all EU-supported Joint Master programmes; the stored row is the catalogue's Sweden country facet with no single consortium, institution, or supervisor attached. Stored URL https://www.eacea.ec.europa.eu/scholarships/emjmd-catalogue_en/sweden returns 404; the current catalogue is at https://www.eacea.ec.europa.eu/scholarships/erasmus-mundus-catalogue_en. Supervisors differ per individual EMJM consortium and cannot be tied to this scheme.

University-wide 50% tuition-fee reduction for high-achieving international students commencing any eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at Adelaide University; assessed by a selection panel on academic merit and no programme or supervising professor is attached to the award. Verified on official page https://adelaide.edu.au/study/scholarships/int/adelaide-academic-excellence-scholarship-50. Only general enquiry channels published (online enquiry form, +61 8 7420 5115), no named staff.

University-wide 25% tuition-fee reduction awarded automatically to high-achieving international students commencing eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework programs at The University of Queensland in any study area; no programme or supervising professor is attached to the award. Verified on official page https://scholarships.uq.edu.au/scholarship/uq-international-excellence-scholarship ('You don't need to apply for this scholarship...'). Only administrative contact published: iasscholarships@uq.edu.au.

The Melbourne Research Scholarship is a university-wide graduate research scholarship awarded automatically to applicants of graduate research degrees, ranked by faculty-based selection panels on academic results and research potential. No supervising professor is named or attached to the scholarship on the official page https://scholarships.unimelb.edu.au/awards/melbourne-research-scholarship; prospective supervisors are arranged separately through the enrolling Faculty at admission, so no professor entry with an official evidence tie can be recorded. Administrative contact: Stop 1 Scholarships (https://ask.unimelb.edu.au/app/ask).

The ANU University Research Scholarship is a centrally managed HDR stipend awarded through ANU's two annual central scholarship rounds to applicants in any College, ranked by College selection committees that consider 'support from the prospective supervisor'. No specific supervising professor is named or attached to the scholarship on the official page https://study.anu.edu.au/scholarships/find-scholarship/anu-university-research-scholarships; applicants are only 'strongly encouraged to make contact with the relevant HDR Convener or a prospective supervisor', so no professor entry with an official evidence tie can be recorded. Administrative contact: Graduate Research School, grs@anu.edu.au.
